summary: Owners can create an empty physical group from New item options. The Add group dialog owns the proposed ID, raw name, colour and board revision. Under current selected-board authorization, store::create_group inserts at the active-group count and advances the board revision in one transaction. A valid replay for the same board-local ID changes nothing.
evidence: All 34 browser_preview cases passed serially in owned headless Chromium. The inherited read-only destination checks caught the closed options menu exposing a button rectangle; explicitly hiding the closed action fixed all six affected journeys.

browser_creates_duplicate_group_in_position_order: the default opened focused with the caret at the end. Blank, Escape and Cancel produced no request. Holding the board lock kept the old grid visible through a second Save gesture. One POST at revision 1 committed A at position 3. Reload showed g-old, A, g-z, g-end with both New group titles, distinct IDs, the accepted blue colour and no heading editor.

browser_reviews_failed_group_create: a deferred insert failure returned 500 at board/2. Before removing the fault a fresh PostgreSQL connection matched the pre-attempt snapshot. The dialog retained B, the padded name and green colour. A peer created at position 4; the explicit stale save returned 409. Review read revision 3; adoption sent nothing. A separate save reused B and committed Work at position 5, board/4. A 503 on the following GET offered Reload board. That read and a document reload showed B once, without another POST.

browser_demoted_owner_cannot_create_group: demotion after opening the dialog produced one 403 and an authorized board read. Member retained item creation; Viewer did not. Neither could create a group. Withdrawing membership denied the destination, and session revocation returned to sign-in. Browser checkpoints compared rendered rows and network exchanges with fresh database snapshots of boards, groups, items, receipts, session and grants.

All 27 loopback_board_access cases passed. The two group-create cases checked populated v9 migration twice, UTF-16 and hex validation, current Owner and grants on create and replay, foreign-key isolation by board, grouped and flat readback, and a two-connection race yielding one 200 and one 409. Replaying the winner at the old revision with different valid fields left it unchanged. Both a deferred commit failure and a 501st projected row preserved the complete pre-attempt snapshot.

Locked workspace tests passed (42), as did workspace formatting and git diff --check. Builds used target-browser-packets and the active disposable database. Node runner regressions were denied by worker shell policy before execution. Lost POST acknowledgments and late completions after leaving the board are handled in the dialog but were not separately fault-injected.
